verdict.rationale: Gusto's own Business Compliance service files state annual and initial reports for the business across all 50 states and alerts users to deadlines, so the filing can be handed off with little owner effort. However, the handoff is to a managed service and concierge team. The documented API, MCP server and CLI cover only Embedded Payroll and payroll work, with no compliance-filing endpoints, so an AI agent cannot be shown to drive the filing. Missing for 10: agent or API access to annual report and compliance filing, evidence of AI-agent preparation, independent hands-on corroboration of low-touch filing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate an annual report or compliance filing to an agent that prepares it through the platform with minimal human input

citations.quote: Annual Report — Files the annual report required by states to maintain a business's good standing with the Secretary of State
